en.title: Buying a YOELEO bike: global store or regional warehouse?
en.description: Compare YOELEO regional and global ordering, clarify shipping and tax promises, and use an older owner build to separate production from transit.
en.intro: A regional store can be useful, but only if your bike is actually in that region. For YOELEO, the first job is to connect the model you want with the shop, warehouse and terms that apply to that exact order.

sections.heading: Follow the brand’s own regional links
paragraphs: YOELEO’s [shipping and delivery page](https://www.yoeleobike.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery) describes the global shop and a European route. Use those links to reach the relevant storefront, rather than assuming every similarly named shop shares stock or support.

Ask whether the exact frame size and finish are ready in the regional warehouse. A regional storefront can still quote a special order fulfilled elsewhere. Confirm the seller on the invoice and the return destination, especially when comparing prices in different currencies.

The ALTERA G21 pictured here is a real current catalog example. It is not the same frame as the older R11 discussed below; photographs and experience from one model do not settle another model’s fit or specification.

sections.heading: Resolve the shipping promises before checkout
paragraphs: Read the [shipping policy](https://www.yoeleobike.com/en-de/policies/shipping-policy) as well as the general delivery page. Pages can describe different routes or contain overlapping estimates. If the wording does not clearly match your order, ask for a written answer instead of selecting the most attractive sentence.

Have the seller break the timeline into preparation, dispatch and transit. Ask which portion is an estimate and what happens if the item is unavailable. If the price is advertised as covering import charges, confirm your destination and who resolves an extra carrier invoice.
An all-inclusive service is a contractual promise about a shipment, not a blanket statement that customs rules do not apply. US, Canada, EU and UK orders need their own answers.

sections.heading: An older R11 build explains a useful distinction
paragraphs: A [2021 R11 owner build](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=3237.0) described ordering in December, dispatch in March and roughly two weeks of transit to Switzerland. The owner’s overall experience was positive, but most of the wait preceded the shipment.

This is a historical account, not a current YOELEO delivery estimate. It is also a Swiss destination, not evidence of EU import treatment. Its transferable lesson is simple: asking how fast the courier is does not tell you when production will finish.

Look for a review of your own generation and build. An older electronic-shifting installation may use different routing and components; a successful old build is not a compatibility certificate for the parts in your shopping cart.

sections.heading: Compare one completed configuration
paragraphs: Specify the frame, cockpit, wheelset, drivetrain and assembly work in each quote. Ask which accessories and proprietary pieces accompany the frameset, and get the matching assembly documentation before ordering parts.

If a regional option costs more, compare the actual benefit: confirmed stock, a closer return address, local assembly or a named support contact. If those remain vague, the premium has not yet bought you anything definite.

Save the configuration and seller’s written answers with the invoice. The useful question is not whether global or regional is always better; it is which route has a clear price and a workable support plan for your particular bike.

zh-Hans.title: YOELEO 购买指南：全球商城还是区域仓？
zh-Hans.description: 比较 YOELEO 全球与区域渠道，问清运输及税费承诺，并借历史车主装车经历区分生产和在途时间。
zh-Hans.intro: 区域商店可能很方便，前提是你想买的车确实在那里。买 YOELEO，先把具体车型与适用的商城、仓库、条款对应起来。

sections.heading: 沿着品牌自己的区域链接找渠道
paragraphs: [YOELEO 运输与交付页面](https://www.yoeleobike.com/pages/shipping-and-delivery)介绍全球商城和欧洲渠道。应沿品牌提供的链接进入相关商店，别假设所有名称相近的店都共享库存或售后。
问清具体尺码和颜色是否已在区域仓。区域商城也可能承接由别处发货的特殊订单。比较不同币种报价时，尤其要确认发票卖家与退货地点。
文中照片展示真实目录车型 ALTERA G21，它不是后文历史经历中的 R11。一个车型的图片或使用经历，不能确定另一个车型的合身和规格。

sections.heading: 结算前，把运输承诺问明白
paragraphs: 除一般运输页，也读[运输政策](https://www.yoeleobike.com/en-de/policies/shipping-policy)。不同页面可能描述不同渠道，或出现重叠的时间估计。如果无法对应你的订单，应取得书面答复，别挑最好听的一句当保证。
请卖家把备货、发出、在途分别说明，并确认哪些只是估计、缺货时如何处理。若宣称包含进口费用，要确认目的地适用，以及额外快递账单由谁解决。
包进口费用是对具体运输的约定，不等于海关规则整体不适用。美国、加拿大、欧盟和英国订单应分别确认。

sections.heading: 老 R11 装车帖带来的实用提醒
paragraphs: [2021 年 R11 车主装车帖](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=3237.0)描述了十二月下单、三月发货，以及约两周运到瑞士。车主总体满意，但大部分等待发生在发货之前。
这是历史记录，不是当前 YOELEO 交期，也不是欧盟进口处理证据，因为目的地是瑞士。可迁移的提醒很简单：问快递有多快，不能得知生产什么时候完成。
寻找你这一代车型和配置的评测。旧电子变速装车可能采用不同走线和部件；老车成功装好，不代表购物车里的新组合已获得兼容认证。

sections.heading: 比较一个完整配置
paragraphs: 每份报价都写清车架、把组、轮组、传动和装配。问车架套装附带哪些配件与专用件，并在购买其他部件前取得对应装配资料。
区域方案较贵时，比较具体收益：已确认库存、更近的退货地址、本地装配或明确售后联系人。若这些仍含糊，差价还没有换来确定的东西。
把配置和书面答复与发票保存。重点不是判定全球或区域渠道永远更好，而是找到对这辆具体车而言价格清楚、售后可执行的路线。
